messages.content: Hey it's pt-1006. My insurance denied my glucose strips. Says they're not on the formulary or something. I need help.

Sorry to hear that. I need to be straight—I can't handle insurance appeals or claims myself. But I can escalate you to our nurses who might be able to help you figure out next steps. Want me to do that?
Yeah, do it. I'm out and can't afford them out of pocket right now.
I'm escalating now. Fair warning: our nurses are running about 31 hours behind currently. They'll reach out to help sort this.
31 hours is pretty long when I need these now. Is there anything faster?
I wish I could help directly, but insurance stuff is outside what I can do. The nurses are your best shot. While we're here—any recent readings or medication changes I should log in your chart?
Nope, I've been pretty stable. Just frustrated about the strips situation.
Totally understandable. You're all set—nurse will contact you within 31 hours. Hang in there.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
